summary: Iter-33 Phase-2 config-engine bridge verified end-to-end on both web (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) and mobile (Expo web preview) plus a shared backend pytest suite. Activation writes engine-backed params into RiskSettings, records active_config_id on strategy_meta, and is reflected by /api/strategy/metrics + /api/analytics/leaderboard. Import validates params (422 on unknown/OOR), Export returns a portable ananta_config JSON blob. Regression: PUT /api/settings still clamps min_confidence>1 -> 1.0. Cleanup: TEST_ configs deleted; RiskSettings restored to demo defaults (rsi_reset_max=35, normal_lot_usd=75, min_confidence=0.7).

ui_bugs.issue: ACTIVATE button on an UNVALIDATED imported config is NOT visually disabled — it appears clickable. The backend still correctly rejects with 400 (safe), but on web the same button is disabled+opacity-30 with a 'Validate this config first' tooltip. Parity gap. Reference: /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx.

parity_issues.issue: Web disables ACTIVATE (+ shows 'Validate this config first' hint) for validation_status != 'passed'. Mobile leaves the ACTIVATE button enabled; user tap is silently rejected by the backend.
parity_issues.expected: ACTIVATE disabled/opacity-40 + explanatory hint on unvalidated rows (parity with web SavedConfigsPanel ConfigRow)
parity_issues.actual: ACTIVATE remains tappable; backend returns 400 with no obvious UI-level guard

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Mobile: disable ACTIVATE + surface a hint on rows where validation_status != 'passed' to match web parity. Backend already enforces the guard, so this is a UX-only fix.

(Optional) Fix 2 iter33 pytest cases (test_import_requires_owner + test_activate_requires_owner) that share requests.Session state across the module — same known-pattern noted in iter29. Real 403 confirmed via unauth curl (see below). Not a security regression.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2058-2101 activate endpoint mutates the live RiskSettings singleton in place and does not persist a 'previous_settings' snapshot. If a bad config is activated, the only way to revert is to re-activate the previous config or manually PUT /api/settings. Consider recording pre/post diff in strategy_meta.history for auditability + one-click revert (already returns 'changes' in response).

server.py:2016 export endpoint is UNAUTHENTICATED (`/api/strategy/configs/{id}/export`). Params from an activated live config are readable by any visitor. Acceptable for owner-only preview, but if this app ever adds multi-tenant/public visitors this leaks strategy tuning.

server.py:2039-2044 import validates params but does NOT enforce a size cap on the payload; a huge JSON blob with 10k unknown keys will each be checked in a loop. Consider bounding payload size / max param count.

success_rate.backend: 100% functional (13/15 pytest; 2 auth-gate assertions are shared-session artifacts — curl confirms real 403)
success_rate.frontend: web 100% (import→row+badges, unvalidated ACTIVATE disabled, validated activate→LIVE, export→clipboard has ananta_config); mobile 95% (all flows work; parity gap on disabled state only)

seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/strategy/seed-defaults (idempotent). Created + then DELETED TEST_web_* and TEST_mob_* imported configs during runs. Also created one 'TEST_unvalidated_*', 'TEST_import_*', 'TEST_roundtrip_*', 'TEST_activate_*' via pytest — cleaned by fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on iter33: (1) BACKEND POST /api/strategy/configs/{id}/activate — owner-only (curl anon -> 403), rejects unvalidated (400), returns {activated, strategy_key, applied>0, changes:[{field,from,to}], note}; strategy_meta.active_config_id set; /api/strategy/metrics AND /api/analytics/leaderboard both surface the new active_config_id. (2) POST /api/strategy/configs/import — accepts both flat {strategy_key,name,params} and exported {config:{...}} shapes; validates via strategy schema (422 on unknown_param & out-of-range rsi_reset_max=9999); rejects unknown strategy (400); stores origin='imported'. (3) GET /api/strategy/configs/{id}/export — returns {ananta_config:1, strategy_key, strategy_version, name, params, origin, meta}; 404 on missing id. (4) GET /api/analytics/leaderboard — 200, {leaderboard:[{rank,key,name,status,health,roi,win_rate,trades,total_pnl,stars,active_config_id}...], count}; sort invariant (health,roi) desc verified. (5) Regression PUT /api/settings min_confidence=5.0 -> stored as 1.0 (clamp works). (6) WEB flow at /: Strategy tab -> Hunter card -> Parameters tab -> Saved Configs panel: 'IMPORT STRATEGY (JSON)' opens textarea (import-config-textarea), submit created imported row (origin='imported', 'unvalidated' visible, ACTIVATE disabled=True); Hunter Conservative BTC (validated) ACTIVATE -> LIVE badge (config-live-demo-hun) renders + only 1 LIVE badge visible; config-export-<id8> click populates clipboard with JSON starting {"ananta_config":1,"strategy_key":"hunter"...}. (7) MOBILE parity at /strategy/[id]: strategy-configs-card + config-import-btn + modal input/submit work; new import row appears with imported+unvalidated tags; ACTIVATE on validated demo-hun -> config-live-demo-hun badge appears. PRIOR polish regression on mobile ALL GREEN: coach-banner, health-score-value, metric-explainer-{health,win_rate,roi}, strategy-academy-link. Post-run cleanup completed: RiskSettings restored to defaults; TEST_* configs deleted.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only a mobile UX parity gap (ACTIVATE not visually disabled on unvalidated configs). Root cause: mobile ConfigRow renders ACTIVATE unconditionally without gating on validation_status. Fix: mirror the web ConfigRow check (`disabled={!isOwner || !validated}`) in /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx around the config-activate-<id8> button.
